feeds.title: Bluegrass Music Association of Maine
feeds.description: The Bluegrass Music Association of Maine is a non-profit organization dedicated to supporting bluegrass music in Maine. BMAM is an organization of listeners and players, who enjoy Bluegrass music. This webpage is maintained to help get the word out about shows, festivals, public invited jams, workshops, and all things bluegrass that are of interest to our members and guests.
